title: alvida aye hussain
body:
alvida aye hussain, aye hussain alvida
Aye rasoole mukarram ke chain alvia
zeenate do jaha'n hai tere naqshe paa
tere sajde kiye maghrabain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
majlise teri har ghar me ho jalwagar
tujhko roti hai dunya hussain alvida
chaandni raat par murdani chaa gayi
kho gaya chaand taaro ka chain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
sar khule faatima aa rahi hai nazar
ro rahe hai shahe mashraqain alvida
aaj shaame gharibaa'n ke hai tazkere
ab bhi roeenge hum poori Rain alvida
<<DIVIDER>>
hum jiyenge to agle baras roenge phir se hoga yahi shore shain alvida
